reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified 22E as a fridge fan fault almost always caused by ice on the fridge evaporator fan, gave a clear safe 24-48h unplugged manual defrost as the sensible first test, and set the right escalation path (Samsung/engineer if it recurs, check warranty) with no unsupported part purchases. Conversation 2 mislocated the fan in the freezer, sent the homeowner hunting for a drain hole they couldn't find, asked impractical questions (listen at night for hissing, judge compressor cycling), and then contradicted itself by telling them they 'don't need to unplug it for 24 hours' before declaring the 'underlying component has failed' and demanding an engineer without ever having the customer try the defrost. Conversation 2's premature certainty about a defrost heater/thermostat failure is an unsupported claim, and it never mentioned warranty checking.
